notes.title: Take Control of Your Life (and Game)... Rebind Inputs and Select Targets
notes.content:
[p]Hey folks,[/p][p][/p][p]I disappeared for a while, but I've been busy... lots of changes for this update. Once again I want to thank [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2F%40inSAMity"]inSAMity[/url] for yet another [url="https://docs.remdigi.com/en/games/smash-n-crash/dlc/tm4r/changelogs/changelog-v03-2025-08-03/suggestions"]very detailed list[/url] of bugs and suggestions -- it has helped me greatly.[/p][p]It took me a while to build (hence why this update took so long), but I also made a package updater. For DLCs hosted on the REMDIGI Content Network, now you just need to run the REMDIGI Package Updater, rather than having to do full download/reinstalls ([url="https://docs.remdigi.com/en/games/smash-n-crash/dlc/tm4r/installation"]see instructions here[/url]).[/p][p]Thanks for the support so far, and if I disappear again, just know that I'm working on something big.[/p][p][/p][p]-- NullReferenceException[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Update Notes (Smash N' Crash v06-2025-08-03)[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]Packages[/b][/p][list][*][p][url="https://docs.remdigi.com/en/games/smash-n-crash/dlc/tm4r/changelogs/changelog-v03-2025-08-03"]DLC changelog (v03-2025-08-03)[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Added Package Updater for package download/syncing
(located in "Smash N' Crash/Package Updater/REMDIGI Package Updater.exe")[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Weapons[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added 30 second destroy for weapon group owner (empty object placeholder) to prevent unnecessary buildup[/p][/*][*][p]Moved pickup count to the weapon preset rather than per-spawner, to allow global adjustment  [/p][/*][*][p]Added destruction of full weapon if the root missile of a weapon group is destroyed (ie. MIRV, Incendiary MIRV)  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug with weapon particle systems showing up at world origin  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed combo weapons not using energy  [/p][/*][*][p]Balanced combo energy usage  [/p][/*][*][p]Added rear firing for more weapons  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]World[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed camera clipping into ground with large vehicles  [/p][/*][*][p]Added lives to deathmatches  [/p][/*][*][p]Added persistent lives to mission sets[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Input[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added input binding changer -- supports different controls per controller (Xbox/DualSense), however same controller models (Xbox/Xbox or DualSense/Dualsense) will share controls due to not having unique device IDs[/p][/*][*][p]Added crosshair system and auto/manual targetting for players to target enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Added button for each vehicle selection to change input profiles  [/p][/*][*][p]Removed navigation from buttons to prevent bugged inputs with controllers, and it now relies on the controller cursor (much more reliable)  [/p][/*][*][p]Increased mouse cursor speed  [/p][/*][*][p]Added input presets
Controller: Default, Arcade | Keyboard: Default, Left-hand Swap (Arrowkeys) [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]Changed UI scaling to height instead of width, due to scaling issues in multiplayer  [/p][/*][*][p]Added camera modes for varying distances  [/p][/*][*][p]Added different colours to life sprites  [/p][/*][*][p]Added backgrounds to volume sliders  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed sliders not working with controller cursor  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed dropdowns not working properly with controller cursor  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed event system not registering current controller cursor selection properly  [/p][/*][*][p]Disabled Navigation events for EventSystem to prevent unwanted controls with controller  [/p][/*][*][p]Updated controller icon spritesheets  [/p][/*][*][p]Changed DualShock-style icons to DualSense icons (will allow custom input icon selection in a future update)  [/p][/*][*][p]Removed the binding display list from the join screen (since it's now handled by the input binding menu)  [/p][/*][*][p]Removed text colour inversion from player UI bars  [/p][/*][*][p]Added Target FPS slider to settings  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Simplified Chinese missing characters  [/p][/*][*][p]Changed covers in DLC menu  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Misc[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added per-playlist music playback type (sequential, shuffle, repeat)  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed cross-scene mission loading  [/p][/*][*][p]Reworked loading screen to allow prioritizing mission data (name, description, thumbnails), over level preset  [/p][/*][*][p]Added "are you sure" confirmation to "quit to menu" button, to prevent accidental presses  [/p][/*][*][p]Added delayed save for settings, to prevent constant save calls when interacting with the UI  [/p][/*][*][p]Added max face count to the face destruction effect, to limit total faces (better for performance)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed language selection loading incorrect language between sessions  [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: July Maintenance Update

I'd like to extend a huge thanks to [url="https://www.youtube.com/@inSAMity"]inSAMity[/url] for a very detailed list of bugs and suggestions. notes.title: The Big Reveal
notes.content: [p]Hey everybody,[/p][p]The day has finally come... after over two and a half years, I'm finally releasing the [url="https://twistedmetal.remdigitalstudios.com/"]big project[/url] to the public. It's been a long, difficult journey -- many sleepless nights, and countless hours of banging my head against the wall -- but I'm happy to say that it is finally done. Cumulatively, between Smash N' Crash and [url="https://twistedmetal.remdigitalstudios.com"]the DLC[/url], I've spent upwards to 3000 hours working, and over the past week I've spent about 16 hours per day for the past 7 days to finally get it finished. Of course though, my work isn't finished, updates will still be provided, and your ideas taken into consideration.[/p][p]Going forward, most small patches for Smash N' Crash should be backwards compatible with the DLCs, unless explicitly stated otherwise. In the case of a major update, then an incompatibility notice will be provided accordingly.[/p][p]That said, I know there are still a bunch of bugs, and I've been working hard to get them patched. I've already received a few complaints stating displeasure towards the state of game... but I also released it as 'Early Access' for a reason. I'll do my best to cater to everybody, supporters and haters alike, I just need time, so please be patient.[/p][p]As always, thanks for supporting the game, your kind words and reviews go a long way for me. I hope this update brings back some nostalgia for you guys, like it does for me.[/p][p]-- NullReferenceException[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Update Notes notes.title: Something Big Is Coming...
notes.content: [p]Hey folks,[/p][p]As stated in the last update, I've been gone all month. Now that I'm back I finally have the time to prepare the big [url="https://twistedmetal.remdigitalstudios.com/"][i]DLC[/i][/url] that everybody has been waiting for. It's almost done, and hopefully should be ready by the end of the week. It's been a long road (figuratively), having spent over 2 years on it. As I finish the DLC, I've been also making updates to Smash N' Crash in preparation for the release. One major change is the mission selection system -- it has been reworked, and now it's easier to select levels/missions directly from the main menu.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45530920/553b5ba5044234d8d658b55d02ef9cdcab73ace8.png"][/img][/p][p]Tune in next week for the big reveal.[/p][p]-- NullReferenceException[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Update Notes (v03-2025-06-30)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Changed level/mission selection to include preview and show individual entries.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed weapons collisions affecting the impact-based health system, which would destroy the owner vehicle.[/p][/*][*][p]Added 1 second delay to music when starting game, to prevent clipping.[/p][/*][*][p]Added version number to splash screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Added vehicle upgrade selection hiding, if there are no selections for a particular section (vehicle model, upgrade slot, upgrade model).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed music player title/artist not separating with line break.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed error for vehicles with more than 4 wheels (index mismatch with wheel pivot and wheel colliders).[/p][/*][*][p]Added check for whether primary color exists on vehicle, and if not then disable the color picker.[/p][/*][*][p]Added point light to vehicle preview to add lighting regardless of global lighting.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: What's Next?
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]Apologies for the delay in updates — I had to rush the early-June release, since I needed to leave for a month-long military safe-driving course (ironic, I know). The last update went up just as I was heading out, and with limited time on weekends, I haven’t had many chances to push fixes since.[/p][p]That said, I’ll be back in July, and there’s a lot still planned. The long-awaited [url="https://twistedmetal.remdigitalstudios.com/"][i]DLC[/i][/url] is nearly ready, and I’ll be focusing on fixing the major bugs and continuing to polish the core game.[/p][p]Smash N’ Crash has been a nearly 3-year solo project, and I’m committed to making it the best it can be — even if it takes time. I appreciate everyone’s support and patience as things come together.[/p][p]Thanks again,
NullReferenceException[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Update Notes (v02-2025-06-15)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed objectives (parachute deploy buttons) not showing properly during Terminal Velocity mission[/p][/*][*][p]Added cutscene/subtitle skipping[/p][/*][*][p]Added "cancel mission" confirmation prompt[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed cursor not showing in options menu while paused[/p][/*][*][p]Updated localization for some UI text[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with some vehicle indexing[/p][/*][*][p]Splash-screen and menu logos is now a dynamic prefab, to support different game modes[/p][/*][*][p]Changed logo animations to use unscaled time so it runs while game is paused[/p][/*][*][p]Added DLC button in main menu to view downloads[/p][/*][*][p]Changed music player radio/playlist icons[/p][/*][*][p]Changed health pickup values[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed graphics quality dropdown indexing backwards[/p][/*][/list]
